decks.notes: This deck focuses on disrupting opponents while being able to deploy threats quickly and efficiently. By combining cheap removal spells, hand disruption, and counter magic, the deck aims to control the game tempo. The inclusion of efficient threats like Murktide Regent and Nethergoyf allows for aggressive plays while still being able to interact with the opponent's game plan. The mana base is optimized for consistency and the use of powerful lands like Wasteland and Underground Sea provide additional disruption. Overall, the deck seeks to be proactive and disruptive in order to secure victory.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly generate mana and cast powerful spells, specifically through using rituals and mana rocks to ramp up quickly. This deck utilizes cards like Burning Wish and Wish to tutor up specific combo pieces, while also having access to powerful draw spells like Galvanic Relay and Echo of Eons to refill the hand. By utilizing fast mana sources like Lion's Eye Diamond and Lotus Petal, this deck aims to combo off and win the game in a single explosive turn, often using cards like Jeska's Will and Rite of Flame to generate large amounts of mana.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive playstyle using low-cost creatures and disruptive spells. By utilizing cards like Mishra's Bauble, Fatal Push, and Thoughtseize to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy, the deck aims to quickly assemble a threatening board presence with cards like Barrowgoyf, Nethergoyf, and Orcish Bowmasters. The deck also includes Sheoldred's Edict and Hymn to Tourach for additional disruption, while leveraging lands like Wasteland to keep the opponent on the back foot.

This UWx Control deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan through counterspells, removal, and card advantage. Utilizing cards like Force of Will, Swords to Plowshares, and Teferi, Time Raveler, the deck aims to control the board while drawing into more answers with cards like Brainstorm and Ponder. The inclusion of Murktide Regent provides a win condition that can quickly close out the game. Leyline Binding and Supreme Verdict offer additional removal options, while Meticulous Archive helps to dig deeper into the deck for more answers.

The main concept of this deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan through a combination of Stax pieces like Trinisphere and Chalice of the Void, as well as graveyard hate with Leyline of the Void. Karn, the Great Creator provides additional control and utility, while cards like Pithing Needle and The One Ring can shut down key opposing threats. The deck also has powerful finishers in Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Fell the Profane. The mana base is optimized for fast and consistent ramping using cards like Ancient Tomb and Chrome Mox.

The deck revolves around quickly assembling the combo of Cephalid Illusionist and Nomads en-Kor to mill your library, allowing you to win the game with Thassa's Oracle or another win condition in your library. It utilizes counterspells like Force of Will and Spell Pierce to protect your combo pieces, while also running disruptive cards like Daze and Prismatic Ending to disrupt your opponent's game plan. The deck also has utility lands like Urza's Saga and Meticulous Archive to help find and protect your combo pieces.

The main focus of this deck is to control the tempo of the game by disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Thoughtseize and Daze while also putting pressure on them with aggressive creatures like Murktide Regent and Brazen Borrower. The deck leverages powerful blue spells like Brainstorm and Force of Will to protect its own threats and maintain board control. The inclusion of cards like Baleful Strix and Fatal Push provides additional removal options, allowing the deck to efficiently deal with threats. The mana base is optimized for consistency and flexibility, ensuring the deck can adapt to various situations.

This deck focuses on disrupting your opponent with a combination of countermagic, discard spells, and removal while putting pressure on them with efficient threats. By controlling the game tempo and keeping your opponent on the back foot, you can quickly close out the game with evasive creatures like Murktide Regent and Brazen Borrower. The deck's strength lies in its ability to disrupt opposing strategies while applying consistent pressure, giving you the edge in the early game and allowing you to maintain control until the end.

The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while maintaining tempo through efficient removal and countermagic. It leverages powerful cards such as Daze, Force of Will, and Thoughtseize to control the game, while cards like Fatal Push and Snuff Out help deal with threats. The inclusion of powerful threats like Murktide Regent and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares help close out the game quickly. The deck also utilizes card draw and manipulation with Brainstorm, Ponder, and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to ensure a steady stream of resources and threats.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize a combination of discard, disruption, and powerful artifacts to control the game and shut down the opponent's strategies. By utilizing cards like Pithing Needle, Trinisphere, Leyline of the Void, Karn, the Great Creator, and Chalice of the Void, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while establishing its own threats like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Orcish Bowmasters. The deck also takes advantage of fast mana sources like Dark Ritual, Chrome Mox, Ancient Tomb, and City of Traitors to quickly deploy its powerful spells and establish dominance on the battlefield.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly and efficiently combo off by using cards like Show and Tell to put powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn into play for free. The deck also includes ways to protect the combo with cards like Force of Will and Spell Pierce. Additionally, the deck includes card draw and manipulation to find key pieces of the combo quickly, making it a potent and streamlined deck with the potential for explosive plays.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and powerful creatures. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while also establishing a strong board presence with cards like Murktide Regent and Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath. The inclusion of cards like Brainstorm and Ponder allow for card selection and manipulation to find key pieces of the deck. Additionally, the mana base includes a variety of fetch lands and dual lands to ensure consistent mana production for the deck's powerful spells.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly get out the powerful creature Emrakul, the Aeons Torn by utilizing the card Show and Tell along with other combo pieces like Omniscience and Cunning Wish. The deck aims to efficiently manipulate the top of the library with cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder, while also having counterspells like Force of Will and Spell Pierce to protect the combo. The inclusion of Ancient Tomb and other fast mana sources allows for a quick setup and execution of the combo, making it a high-risk, high-reward strategy in Legacy format duels.

This UWx Control deck is focused on maintaining control of the game through card advantage, counterspells, and removal spells. The deck utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student, along with efficient removal spells such as Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending. The deck also includes card selection and manipulation spells like Ponder and Brainstorm to ensure consistency in drawing key cards. The deck aims to disrupt opponents' strategies while developing its own game plan to ultimately outvalue and outlast the opponent.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively control the game by using efficient counterspells and removal spells while also putting pressure on the opponent with creatures like Delver of Secrets, Questing Druid, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while quickly closing out the game with a combination of damage from creatures and direct damage spells like Lightning Bolt. Additionally, the deck has land disruption capabilities with cards like Wasteland to further disrupt the opponent's mana base.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy while applying pressure with efficient creatures. It plays disruptive spells like Thoughtseize, Force of Will, and Daze to control the game. It also runs removal spells like Fatal Push and Drown in the Loch to deal with threats. The creatures in the deck, such as Brazen Borrower and Murktide Regent, provide aggression and value. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student acts as a card advantage engine. The deck aims to control the tempo of the game and outvalue the opponent to secure victory.
